title: AI Engineer | Foundation Models | Pre-training & Post-training
about_me_p:
I’m a Colombian AI engineer based in Japan, specializing in the pre-training and post-training of foundation models. I’m drawn to the work behind the model: how it learns, where its capabilities come from, and what it takes to turn those capabilities into useful behavior.

My focus spans two closely connected challenges: building strong foundations through pre-training, and refining model behavior through post-training. What interests me most is the connection between them—how choices made during training show up in the answers a model gives, the mistakes it makes, and the limits of what it can do.

For me, a compelling demo is the beginning of the conversation. I want to understand why something works, where it breaks, and how to make it better. That curiosity is what keeps me building, experimenting, and digging deeper into the systems behind modern AI.
